prompt:
I'm a product manager at a B2B SaaS company and I'm completely overwhelmed by emails. I've exported today's batch of 6 incoming emails into a file at `/workspace/incoming_emails.json`. I need you to use the Email Assistant skill to process all of them and produce a single structured report file called `email_report.json`.

The report must cover three things:
1. A classification of every single email (all 6 of them) by its type — I need to be able to quickly glance and know which ones need immediate attention vs. which ones are just noise.
2. A full list of action items / to-dos extracted from the emails that actually contain tasks — each todo must include when it's due, how urgent it is, and which email it came from.
3. A priority-sorted view of those to-dos using a proper urgency-vs-importance framework, so I know what to tackle first thing tomorrow morning.

Please process the emails and save the complete structured output to `email_report.json`.
